final.answer: Yes — flanged ends are available. The valve catalog description (ET/EAT/ETR series) lists flanged raised-face end connections per EN 1092-1, RF or RTJ flanged CL150, CL300 and CL600 for steel/stainless bodies, and CL125 FF or CL250 RF flanged for cast iron bodies, in various valve sizes. Buttweld, socket weld and screwed ends are also available, so you can choose flanged rather than being limited to buttweld or screwed. The description does not, however, state which end connection this specific FV-104-2 installation actually has.

final.answer: The valve operated by loop FIC-106-2 (control valve FV-106-2) is a Fisher ET sliding-stem control valve.
